chapterTitle: Chapter 16 Chemistry of Benzene: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution
title: Problem 16-11

pages.text: PROBLEM 16-11 An electrostatic potential map of (trifluoromethyl)benzene, C6H5CF3, is shown. Would you expect (trifluoromethyl)benzene to be more reactive or less reactive than toluene toward electrophilic substitution? Explain.
